summary: Energy Transfer LP filed an 8-K reporting entry into a November 5, 2026 underwriting agreement with Barclays, Deutsche Bank, Morgan Stanley, RBC and Wells Fargo as joint book-running managers for a $2.7 billion investment-grade debt offering: $900 million 5.450% Senior Notes due 2032, $900 million 5.900% Senior Notes due 2037 and $900 million 6.550% Senior Notes due 2057, registered on Form S-3. Net proceeds of roughly $2.68 billion are earmarked to refinance commercial paper and revolver borrowings plus general partnership purposes; closing is expected November 20, 2026. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for pricing/spread and leverage effects.
